en.HELP_DESC:
ProMcBot provides an easy way to link your Minecraft server to Discord. You can view server info and control it with one click.

### 🛠️ Basic Commands:
> **/server setup**
> To setup Minecraft server by choosing type from menu.

> **/server remove**
> To disable link and remove server data from bot.

> **/moderation settings**
> To view current automod settings.

### ${client.emojis.LINK} Useful Links:
• [Support](https://discord.gg/6FjFYStz5a)
• [Invite Bot](https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=1220005260857311294&permissions=537250992&integration_type=0&scope=bot+applications.commands)

zh.HELP_DESC:
ProMcBot 提供了一种将您的我的世界服务器链接到 Discord 的简便方法。您可以一键查看服务器信息并进行控制。

### 🛠️ 基础命令：
> **/server setup**
> 通过从菜单中选择类型来设置我的世界服务器。

> **/server remove**
> 禁用链接并从机器人中删除服务器数据。

> **/moderation settings**
> 查看当前的自动管理设置。

### ${client.emojis.LINK} 有用链接：
• [技术支持](https://discord.gg/6FjFYStz5a)
• [邀请机器人](https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=1220005260857311294&permissions=537250992&integration_type=0&scope=bot+applications.commands)

es.HELP_DESC:
ProMcBot ofrece una forma sencilla de vincular tu servidor de Minecraft con Discord. Puedes ver la información del servidor y controlarlo con un clic.

### 🛠️ Comandos básicos:
> **/server setup**
> Para configurar tu servidor de Minecraft eligiendo el tipo en el menú.

> **/server remove**
> Para desactivar el enlace y eliminar los datos del servidor del bot.

> **/moderation settings**
> Para ver la configuración actual del automod.

### ${client.emojis.LINK} Enlaces útiles:
